checks.title: Confirm refund goal and owners
checks.instructions: Name billing reviewer, finance owner, approval authority, customer entity and first reviewable result. Decide whether existing Crews meet access and independence boundaries.

checks.title: Bind exact customer request
checks.instructions: Record customer/request ID, payment or charge ID, provider account and mode, currency, requested amount, reason, timestamp, privacy scope and source revision.

checks.title: Verify refund policy and arithmetic
checks.instructions: Read original payment and all succeeded or pending refunds. Reproduce remaining-balance arithmetic in minor units; record policy version, exceptions, owner and exact approval limit.

checks.title: Bind both Crew roles
checks.instructions: Inspect existing Crew IDs and permissions. Reuse Billing Operations with its Refund Review pack and Revenue & Close where compatible; propose reviewed creation only if needed.

checks.title: Probe provider and finance records
checks.instructions: Read one real authorized payment/refund set and current ledger or export. Record source IDs, observation times and unavailable coverage. A named connector alone is not proof.

checks.title: Validate decision and reconciliation
checks.instructions: Run the packaged validator on refund-decision/v1 before Finance consumes it and on refund-reconciliation/v1 after Finance re-reads sources. Reject identity or currency mismatch, over-refund, unsupported processed state or missing receipt.

checks.title: Review concrete Automation and actions
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, artifact paths, validator steps, approval owner, exact action boundary, idempotency, receipt store, contact policy, retry, cost, and manual first route.

checks.title: Run one real request manually
checks.instructions: Produce and owner-review one decision and finance readout from authorized current records. Save validations, corrections, receipts or none, and a truthful state. Fictional examples do not complete setup.

checks.title: Record provider and ledger outcomes
checks.instructions: Distinguish pending decision, denied, approved but unprocessed, processed but unreconciled and reconciled. Bind exact provider and ledger receipts or name the missing proof.

checks.title: Choose manual or reviewed repeat rule
checks.instructions: Keep manual-only or separately review a bounded authenticated event/schedule, exact request key, deduplication, retries, cost and notifications. Setup does not enable a refund.
